headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth, driven by AI‑related sales.
summary: Most major players reported double‑digit revenue increases YoY. TCS led with ₹73,188 cr and a 24% operating margin. HCLTech and L&T Technology highlighted strong AI contributions. Profit trends were mixed, with Persistent seeing a sharp decline.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue boost
themes.detail: AI sales lifted HCLTech profit 21% YoY and contributed 10% of TCS revenue. L&T Technology saw AI revenue rise 47% YoY.

leaders.why: Highest YoY revenue growth at 21.2% and solid profit expansion.

laggards.why: Profit fell 27% YoY and operating margin slipped to 15%.
